description: Concurrent Force Reporter, step 1. Reads the open CIVIL NX model the way the plugin does when it connects and lists what a concurrent-forces run can use: every load case and combination (all ten LCOM tables) with how MIDAS addresses it, whether it is envelope-valued, and whether it is AVAILABLE — moving load, settlement, response spectrum, ABS and SRSS (anywhere down the combination tree) cannot give a coexistent state and are listed with the reason and the workaround; the items the model has per result source (beam/truss/plate elements, general/elastic links, node reactions/displacements); the key effects available for them (keyEffect ids such as BEAM:Moment-y, REACTION:FZ, ELASTICLINK:Axial, with units); structure groups (element and node ranges, links found on their nodes); construction stages with their step tokens; criteria and output positions; the model's units; whether results are published. Read-only. Use search to narrow a long case list; includeConstituents shows each combination's children.

includeConstituents.description: List each combination's children (name, factor, analysis kind).

limit.description: At most this many load case entries.

search.description: Only load cases / combinations whose name contains this (case-insensitive).

units.description: Units to report in (MIDAS converts). Default: the model's own.
